basics.name: adminPassword
basics.toolTip: Password for the CloudSmith administrator account. Must be at least 12 characters and contain uppercase, lowercase, digit, and special character.

constraints.validationMessage: Password must be at least 12 characters and contain uppercase, lowercase, a digit, and a special character.

elements.name: environmentName
elements.label: Environment
elements.toolTip: The environment tier. Used as a prefix for Azure resource names (e.g. rg-cloudsmith-dev-eus-001).

elements.name: imageTag
elements.label: Container Image Tag
elements.toolTip: The CloudSmith container image version to deploy. Use 'v1.0.0' for the latest stable release. Do not use 'latest' in production.

constraints.validationMessage: Must be a valid container tag (e.g. v1.0.0, main, or a SHA digest).

elements.name: postgresAdminUser
elements.label: Database Administrator Username
elements.toolTip: Username for the PostgreSQL administrator account.

constraints.validationMessage: Must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, or underscores (2–63 characters).

elements.name: costCenter
elements.label: Cost Center
elements.toolTip: Cost center tag applied to all deployed resources. Used for billing allocation.

elements.name: ownerEmail
elements.label: Owner Email
elements.toolTip: Email address of the team or individual responsible for this deployment. Used for budget and alert notifications.

options.text: CloudSmith will be deployed to Azure Container Apps in the selected resource group. Deployment takes approximately 15–20 minutes. After deployment completes, the Portal URL and API URL will be shown in the Outputs tab of the deployment. See https://docs.cloudsmith.cloud for full documentation.

Resources that will be created: Log Analytics Workspace, Application Insights, Azure Monitor Workspace, User-Assigned Managed Identity, Key Vault, PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Container Apps Environment, CloudSmith API Container App, CloudSmith Portal Container App.
